apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- The Events tab's buttons take much less room, so the first game shows
  without scrolling: Start match and Log match sit side by side, with small
  Import and Calendar buttons below. Both are also in the season's ⋮ menu

- Games on the same day are ordered by kickoff time: in Results the latest
  game is on top and the earliest at the bottom; Upcoming lists the earliest
  first. Games with no kickoff time count as the start of their day
- Importing a schedule or results now saves the Match # onto games already in
  the app that don't have one (shown as "Match #: none → 935"), even when
  nothing else changed
- Imports compare every game detail and update whatever differs: score,
  date (rescheduled games), kickoff, home/away, location, opponent name,
  Match #, game vs friendly, and notes (added to yours, never replacing
  them). Your player's stats (goals, assists, shots, minutes, position,
  cards, play-by-play) are never touched
- Results show your player's goals and assists as colored chips (green ⚽,
  blue 👟), so games they contributed to stand out; games with neither show
  just the score
- The Match # shows as a small badge at the start of a game's date line
- 👟 is now the assist icon everywhere (results, milestones, recap image)

- Games can have a Match # (read from the schedule, or typed in the match
  form), shown on game cards
- Fixed: importing results with two games on one day could put both results
  on the same game. Imports now pair each game with at most one game in the
  app, using the Match # first, then date + kickoff, then date + opponent,
  and only then date alone when it's the only game that day on both sides.
  A game the app can't pair for sure is added as new, with a note to check
  for a duplicate
- A game paired by Match # on a different date (rescheduled) gets its new date

- Import results from a photo: the schedule import also reads final scores.
  Results fill in games already in the app (matched by date) and mark them
  played; games that aren't in the app yet are added with their score. Each
  game is labelled New, Update score, Update details or Already in app before
  you save, and scores can be fixed in the list
- For games already in the app, the list shows exactly what would change
  (score, opponent name, kickoff, location, home/away — "old → new"). The
  photo's details replace the old ones unless you tick "Keep the app's
  details" on that game

- The Stats tab is now your player's career page: totals and goals per game,
  milestones, a by-season table (with their number and the team's record),
  goals & assists by season, and their best game. Pick a season to zoom in
- Milestones: every 10 career goals and assists, first goal for each team,
  hat tricks, and scoring streaks of 3+ games
- Season Stats tab: a results strip (tap a game) and goals & assists by game
  bars replace the line chart
- Game recap: a shareable picture of a game (score, result, your player's
  goals and assists, photo and milestones). Opens after Done on the live
  screen, and from Share recap on any played game
- Head-to-head: upcoming games show your last results against that opponent
  (any season), or "First meeting"
- Friendlies don't count toward any stats (career totals, milestones, best
  game, charts, season totals, head-to-head); they still show in the Events
  list and can be shared as a recap
